First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before the meet time. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: social, ~1,000 ft of climbing.
Check
Look at @gaygravelgrouppdx the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Gay Gravel Group group ride

A queer-led Wednesday gravel ride up into Forest Park, open to everyone. Meets at Cycle Town Coffee in Northwest and climbs about a thousand feet on the fire lanes. Listed weekly on the Shift calendar.
